consumer: the engine's active input-dispatch site that consumes a registered move-east action and advances the turn by deducting moves, asking 'execute one eastward step at keypress cost'
scope: a registered player movement action driven through the engine's own active input loop so it actually relocates the avatar and spends a turn
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar (scalars) — only serializes read-only avatar getters (get_moves/get_hp/...) into snapshot JSON; it reports state, it never invokes a movement action or input dispatch
divergence: avatar adjacent to an open tile east: exporting moves/stamina reports unchanged scalars but the avatar never relocates and no turn is consumed, so the goal silently fails while the surface looks 'answered'
